note: The script asks for four graphics: the hook text, the facility line, the key word and brackets on the book notes, then the client's end card. The other rows are captions only. The Freedom Reads logo file is still owed, so the end card types the name.

mg.title: Hook text
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top third: Take our name back. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Facility line
mg.cue: Context line at 00:03 for 3 s, top third: Washington Corrections Center for Women
mg.use: Put it on at 00:03 for 3 s, top third. No name cards. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Key word
mg.cue: Key word, top third, as she says it (about 00:21): endangered
mg.use: Put it on as she says “endangered”, about 00:21, top third, 2 s. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Brackets on the notes
mg.cue: Brackets on the notes in the book margin as she says the line about the hearts (about 00:37), 2 s, only if the shot shows the page.
mg.use: Brackets only, no label. Put them around the notes in the book margin as she says “Little hearts”, about 00:37, for 2 s. Skip it if the shot does not show the page.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Freedom Reads name, typed until James sends the logo. Then Freedom Libraries, then Follow @freedombeginswithabook
